registration: Evaluation implementation specified before any v27 test inference; development outcomes have already been inspected.
required_selections: All 15 author-core runs (ARMR and GAMENet in two panels, SafeDrug in molecular only; three seeds each), six five-round rule runs, and both conventional-control panels must freeze before any test prediction. Missing, failed or unaudited jobs are not zeros.
required_audits: Source/model hashes, cohort/control audits, all 90 reconstructed cross-fitting folds, scalar witness decisions, candidate evidence and saved-policy development predictions, and selected author checkpoint/guard reproduction. Author historical epoch metrics are retained logs, not independently rerun checkpoints; only selected and last author weights were retained.
selected_methods: Prevalence, last visit, cosine kNN, structured logistic; each declared author architecture; all six rule arms. Keep the uniform rule policy and full-data logistic separately even if their selected weights/predictions coincide. No best-method relabeling.
learning_curves: Evaluate every already frozen round of all six rule arms, not only an accepted-state envelope. Round choice stays proposal-only; test curves cannot change selection. Report case counts, memory sizes/hashes and accepted edits.
interventions: At the own-error agent's selected round: remove memory with its selected policy/threshold; substitute its first-round memory; substitute its first-round policy and its threshold while keeping selected memory. No retuning. These isolate retained artifacts but do not reproduce independent counterfactual learning trajectories.
scoring: Independent class-string set scorer retains full-panel OOV ground truth and molecular-panel empty targets. Empty-empty agreement is one. Patient mean is the average of within-patient visit means. Report F1/Jaccard, micro F1/precision/recall, mean size, empty prediction/target rates, zero/nonzero target strata and known-DDI graph rates with source coverage. DDI is not clinical safety.
uncertainty: Three-seed means and sample standard deviations. For own-error agent versus every comparator, average the observed seed-specific patient scores first, then 4000 paired patient bootstrap resamples, RNG42. Deterministic controls contribute one fixed prediction, not three independent runs. Intervals are conditional on observed seeds, exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
publication: Public code, aggregate metrics and hashes; private predictions, patient keys, models and detailed source records stay local. Full and molecular panels never pool. Earlier observed-test overlap remains disclosed. No claim of prospective clinical correctness or universal superiority.
